plate_budget_abstraction: Each round uses two 96-well plates: 160 agent-selected variant assay wells plus 32 reserved control/QC wells.
objective: Minimize wet-lab measured ddG for single mutants. Lower measured_ddg is better; measured_ddg < 0 is stabilizing relative to WT.

hidden_score.name: mean_final_ddg
hidden_score.definition: Mean hidden measured_ddg of the unmeasured final recommendations. The already-measured final file is required for a valid handoff and does not enter this number.

query_rules: For rounds 1, 2, and 3, write results/round_1_batch.csv, results/round_2_batch.csv, and results/round_3_batch.csv, then send the corresponding round and queries through the framework validation action.
Each round batch must contain exactly 16 variants per episode from design_space.csv, for 160 variant assays per round.
Each round row must include episode_id, rank, variant_id, pred_ddg, pred_uncertainty, and acquisition_type.
acquisition_type must be one of: exploit, explore, diversity, risk_control, hypothesis_test.
For each round, also write a 192-row plate map with 160 variant_assay wells matching the batch and 32 control/QC wells.
Do not query the same variant_id more than once across rounds.
Use returned wet-lab measurements to revise later-round decisions; do not run three independent one-shot screens.
Submit results/final_validated_batch.csv with exactly 8 previously measured variants per episode.
Submit results/final_prospective_batch.csv with exactly 8 unmeasured design-space variants per episode.
Write hypothesis_ledger_round_*.json files that cite only public pilot variants or already returned wet-lab measurements as evidence.

rules: round must equal the round number in the file name.
Every evidence value must match a public pilot row or a measurement returned no later than this round.
Every next_tests entry for rounds 1 and 2 must appear in the following round batch; round 3 entries must appear in final_prospective_batch.csv.
expected_direction must be stabilizing, destabilizing, or uncertain.
